0022600091.text: Both the Dallas Mavericks and Houston Rockets are opening their 2026-27 seasons, with the Mavericks on the road. Dallas's unavailable players are Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Santi Aldama (knee), and Tarik Biberovic (heel), while Jett Howard (calf) is day-to-day and a game-time decision; Houston's Julian Phillips (illness) and Steven Adams (calf soreness) are also day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and their most recent meeting was on January 31, 2026, in Houston, where the Mavericks lost 111-107.
